```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(coclustOrdinal)
```

## Model

(TODO) CUB distribution, latent block model, SEM-Gibbs, ICL.

## Simulated data

```{r simulate}
sim <- simulate_cub_lbm(n = 80, d = 40, m = 5, seed = 1)
dim(sim$X)
```

## Fitting the model

```{r fit}
fit <- coclust_ordinal(sim$X, K = 2, L = 2, n_init = 5,
                       n_iter = 50, burn_in = 20, seed = 1)
summary(fit)
```

```{r compare}
table(estimated = fit$row_clusters, true = sim$z)
table(estimated = fit$col_clusters, true = sim$w)
```

## Choosing the number of blocks with ICL

```{r select}
sel <- coclust_ordinal_select(sim$X, K_range = 1:3, L_range = 1:3,
                              n_init = 3, n_iter = 40, burn_in = 15, seed = 1)
sel$table
```
